author: Arachadonic
body:
So as the title says I am thinking of making a map build team of just a few people who have decent skills in building. I myself am a decent builder but where I come into play is that I would host the server out of my own money and be in charge of organising people, files, plugins etc.

I want it to be like a democracy though so I had an idea of having a plot world, then you show me a rough sketch of your concept or idea and once you are finished everyone looks at it and if the majority votes yes then we all work on it, if no then we leave it or you fix it. I believe this will work well as unless people have an interest in what they are building then they won't put really as much effort into it.

Once the server gets up I might make a little forums aswell just for easiness of communication. Of course that depends if people have an interest or not. If people do join then Ill make the server and it shouldn't take long but while you are waiting for it to come up you can be thinking of ideas. I might add different ranks later like "Terrain" "Overseer" "Builder" etc later.

Fill out the format if you are interested:
Username:
Age:
Skype:
Photos/Proof of past builds:
Why you want to join?:

I hope this is okay to post there and talk about another server.. its only small and will only serve as a place to build a map for this server.
